consistency.const: MUST REPRODUCE in every generation of this individual

honours.description: #104 individual honours: STORED stamps on the individual record (shape: show/production/species-data/honours-fragment.json). A stamp without a resolvable earning fact is a data error. The honour catalogue itself is OPEN owner content.

location.description: #106 storage: ONE field on the roster record — storage is a view over the roster, not a second database; the three kinds make double-placement impossible. Release is a tombstone fact in save history and never reverts #14's kept state.

keeperHistory.description: #168 keeper history (seat chosen at the List 18 landing: the individual record, where #80's model lives — ONE home; #68's protocol doc cross-references this field). Each entry records a transfer of care under 168-RANGER-TRADING.md; escrow state is part of the transfer record, and while a record is escrowed no release and no location move may be written for it (escrow-lock).

nickname.description: #239 nickname (List 25): set through exactly TWO doors — the set-at-keep offer in #38's keep flow, and the name service in the #132/#162 service layer (one defined write). No other writer may touch this field; a wild individual is never nicknamed (a write-permission fact, testable in the schema's consumers).

heart.description: #287 (List 30) closed-heart record, landed here citing it — ABSENT or null = open heart (#96 absent = default). Stored, not derived (argument in #287 / heart-fragment.json). The three fences land as validation on this record: gain events on a closed individual route to bankedGain (#177 bank), no #199 evolution edge fires while closed, and no consumer may write personality_seed from heart facts. personality_seed itself is never written by this system.

gauge.description: Current closure remaining; 0 = ready to open (#288).

gaugeMax.description: Set at closing from the individual's facts + cause class.

bankedGain.description: #177 gain events held in reserve while closed — paid out whole at opening (#288); never applied, never lost. Shape as recorded in #287's fragment; no numeric type was asserted there, so none is asserted here.

closedBeat.description: #12-class beat the closure happened, per #287's fragment.

title: Mochi individual record — variance + ruled deviations (List 9, #80). Deviation entries with status RULED require ruled_by/ruled_on/source; generators may only read RULED deviations. Deviations are feature-level only — palette variation per individual is prohibited by the Lustre Law and has no field here.
